caption: Birthday cake for my baby who’s turning 1 soon 🫠🎈  Carrot cake for babies (no added sugar recipe): * 1/3 cup of grated carrots * 2 eggs * 1/2 banana, mashed * 1 tablespoon of greek yogurt * 5 tablespoons of coconut flour * 1 teaspoon of baking soda (or use half, for less bitterness, I tend to be ok with baking soda, but some might be more sensitive to bitterness caused by baking soda) Bake the mixture at 325 F, for 20-30 min.
